items.title: Test-Time Self-Evolving GUI Visual Grounding via Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.title_zh: 反思引导的在线策略自蒸馏：测试时自演化的 GUI 视觉定位
items.summary: The framework enables GUI agents to keep improving after deployment without human-annotated ground truth by closing a loop of exploration, evaluation, reflection and internalization, with an MLLM reflector and reflection-guided on-policy self-distillation turning reasoning into token-level supervision. Across six benchmarks it improves average accuracy by 7.4% over the base model, which the authors describe as the first successful use of on-policy self-distillation for test-time adaptation in GUI visual grounding.

items.title: Semantic Graph Unification for Industrial Digital Threads: Bridging 11 Heterogeneous Manufacturing Systems Through Ontology-Driven Knowledge Graphs
items.title_zh: 工业数字线程的语义图统一：用本体驱动知识图谱桥接 11 个异构制造系统
items.summary: The paper presents an ontology-driven RDF knowledge graph that unifies 11 simulated manufacturing sources across nine domains through a five-stage ETL pipeline with automated entity resolution, covering 78 RDFS classes and 108 object properties. Blocking 24 cross-system tools cuts recall from 1.00 to 0.31, indicating that 69% of discoverable signals require cross-system graph joins, and the graph is exposed to LLM agents through 287 MCP tools.

items.title: Tencent's SkillHub Crosses 100,000 Skills and Ten Million Monthly Downloads — and a TRACE Evaluation Layer Is Why Maybe Twenty Percent Still Matter
items.title_zh: 腾讯 SkillHub 技能数突破 10 万，月下载量超千万
items.summary: SkillHub, the OpenClaw-aligned AI skill community hosted by Tencent Lighthouse Cloud, now lists more than 100,000 AI skills and over 10 million monthly downloads, with a TRACE evaluation framework deciding which skills matter.

items.title: Social Chain of Thought: A Multi-Agent Architecture Grounded in Medical Differential Diagnosis Methodology
items.title_zh: 社会思维链：扎根医学鉴别诊断方法的多智能体架构
items.summary: SCoT structures multi-agent interaction for medical differential diagnosis as a multi-round deliberative pipeline and evaluates it against single-agent baselines, one-agent pipeline ablations and best-of-n scaling. The authors report that its recall advantage is not reproduced by monolithic inference alone and is largest on the hardest cases, where multiple rounds of specialist conversation help recover ground-truth diagnoses.

items.title: From Prompting to Behavioral Alignment: Personalized LLM Judges for Recommendation Evaluation
items.title_zh: 从提示到行为对齐：面向推荐评估的个性化 LLM 评判器
items.summary: The study identifies bidirectional rationalization, where zero-shot LLMs convincingly argue for both positive and negative engagement on the same item with identical evidence, and addresses it with a sequential behavioral alignment framework that pairs fine-tuning with preference optimization over correct and counterfactual rationales. On real homepage interaction logs the aligned approach gains 32.19% in Macro-F1 over the zero-shot baseline and matches the production feature-engineered baseline.

items.title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
items.title_zh: 通过技能-执行框架演化实现自演化具身智能体
items.summary: SHAPER is a train-free framework for embodied adaptation that keeps model parameters frozen and improves the non-parametric agent system by evolving reusable skills and a context-code harness through target-environment rollouts. The same frozen model serves as both planner and optimizer, and experiments on VLABench and ESI-Bench compare it with pure execution, supervised fine-tuning and test-time-scaling baselines.

items.title: Can Frontier LLMs Match Natively Multimodal Embeddings? A Comparison on Hard-Negative Text-to-Image Retrieval
items.title_zh: 前沿 LLM 能否媲美原生多模态嵌入？硬负样本文本到图像检索对比
items.summary: The study provides a first direct comparison of native multimodal embeddings against LLM-based visual ranking on hard-negative Flickr30k retrieval. It finds GPT-4.1 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 perform on par with Gemini Embedding 2, and notes that once embeddings are precomputed, multimodal embeddings are better suited to low-latency applications.

items.title: Deployment Decision Reliability: A Generalizability-Theory Framework for Sizing Long-Horizon Agent Evaluations
items.title_zh: 部署决策可靠性：为长程智能体评估确定规模的概化理论框架
items.summary: Using a four-facet Generalizability Theory variance decomposition across TheAgentCompany, τ²-bench and AppWorld, the paper finds the agent main effect accounts for less than 3% of total variance while agent-by-task interaction accounts for 7–23%, meaning leaderboards rank specialization rather than capability. It also reports that aggregate reliability collapses on the hardest task quartile and packages the findings into a one-page reporting discipline called Deployment Decision Reliability.

items.title: From Numbers to Judgment: Specialist LLM Agents and Reinforcement Learning for European Listed Real Estate
items.title_zh: 从数字到判断：面向欧洲上市房地产的专业 LLM 智能体与强化学习
items.summary: Larix maps a 16-lens European listed real-estate analysis framework to eight lens-aligned specialists and compares monolithic versus specialist-decomposed prompting while holding model, evidence, instructions, schema and scoring fixed. Decomposition improves the numerical-task aggregate by 15.8 percentage points but can reduce judgment performance, while GRPO post-training of Qwen3.5-9B raises the judgment aggregate by 14.2 points and transfers to unseen firms.
